evidence.dominant_driver: Import prices rose 0.7% m/m versus roughly 0.4% expected, led by nonfuel imports; this adds inflation pressure into an already-priced Fed hike.

market_expectations.distribution_notes: Fed 25bp hike was already overwhelmingly priced before the release.

absorption.reason: Release is more than four hours old; equities subsequently traded higher and yields/oil eased. Forecast targets only residual move from decision time.

evidence.decision_notes: Delayed data-release story. Residual forecast from 16:59:08Z, immediately before the 18:00Z FOMC decision; Fed event risk dominates 15m/1h.

regimes.rates: high but easing from intraday peak

immediate.rationale: FOMC is imminent; the import-price shock has been trading for hours.

next_session.rationale: Post-Fed rates and oil path dominate this already-absorbed release.

15m.rationale: FOMC is imminent; the import-price shock has been trading for hours.

1h.rationale: Fed communication dominates immediate price discovery.

4h.rationale: Hot import prices are hawkish, but yields have eased and risk assets are firmer.

next_session.rationale: Post-Fed rates and oil path dominate this already-absorbed release.

predictions.mechanism: Import prices +0.7% m/m vs about +0.4% expected; nonfuel prices drove the increase while fuel import prices fell.
